title: Network Solutions Review 2026: Plans, Renewal Prices, Speed Tests and Support
excerpt: Network Solutions is easy to start with and has phone support, but tests found it slower than most rivals and renewal costs about three times the promo price.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Network Solutions Review 2026: Prices, Speed, Support
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Network Solutions hosting review for 2026: plan prices and renewals, speed and uptime from independent tests, phone support, AI builder, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: Network Solutions is an easy, phone-supported start for small sites. Independent tests found below-average speed and 99.89% uptime, and renewal is about three times the promo price.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Network Solutions good for hosting? | It is easy for beginners and has phone support. Tests found speed below average and renewals about three times the promo price.
How much does Network Solutions hosting cost? | Starter is $2.99 a month and renews at $8.83. Essential is $4.99 renewing at $15.42, and Premium is $6.99 renewing at $18.75.
How fast is Network Solutions? | HostWise measured a 402 ms median time to first byte and a 2,280 ms Largest Contentful Paint over 34 weeks.
Is Network Solutions reliable? | HostWise measured 99.89% uptime and HostDean saw no major outages. The guarantee is 99.9% with exclusions.
Does Network Solutions have phone support? | Yes. HostWise lists 24/7 phone and chat.
Does Network Solutions have a money-back guarantee? | We did not find one on the hosting page we read.
Does Network Solutions have a free domain? | Yes, for one domain on an annual term. The free SSL certificate covers one annual term on Essential and Premium. Starter has no free SSL.
Is Domain.com the same as Network Solutions? | Domain.com is becoming Network Solutions, per HowToHosting, and new hosting purchases route there.
Does Network Solutions have AI features? | Yes. Its hosting page lists a drag-and-drop AI Website Builder, and HostingAdvice praised it.
Does Network Solutions have hidden fees? | Reviewers warn about checkout add-ons, auto-renewal by default and expensive domain and SSL renewals.
Does Network Solutions have a Black Friday deal? | Its blog lists SITEWIDE30 for 30% off an AI All-Access Pack from 23 November to 7 December 2026. It is not a hosting discount.
Who should avoid Network Solutions? | People who want fast pages, a low price for years or a simple checkout.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Starter is $2.99 a month and renews at $8.83, about three times higher.
HostWise measured a 402 ms median time to first byte and 99.89% uptime over 34 weeks.
Network Solutions offers 24/7 phone and chat support.
Domain.com is becoming Network Solutions, per HowToHosting.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Network Solutions is a simple, supported start for a small site and a poor choice for speed or long-term price. Tests found below-average speed, and renewals are about three times the promo price. Read the checkout carefully.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You want an easy start and phone support.
You want one company for your domain and your site.
You will read add-ons and renewal terms carefully.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You want fast pages and strong Core Web Vitals.
You want a low price for years.
You dislike upselling at checkout.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Easy sign-up and an AI website builder that HostingAdvice liked.
24/7 phone and chat support.
Uptime close to the 99.9% guarantee.
Clear renewal prices on the plan page.
meta.rl_r_cons:
Renewal is about three times the promo price.
Below-average speed, with no CDN or NVMe storage.
Heavy upselling and auto-renewal by default.
Expensive domain and SSL renewals.
No money-back guarantee on the page we read.
meta.rl_r_best: Beginners who want phone support and an easy start
